process.title: Brief and measure
process.text: Tell us how you use the kitchen and we measure the room.

process.title: Design
process.text: We develop the layout and finishes, with 3D views where useful. Already have your architect's or designer's drawings? We work from those.

process.title: Detailed written quotation
process.text: You receive a written quotation for the kitchen as designed.

process.title: Made in Drumree
process.text: Your kitchen is made in our workshop.

process.title: Fitted by our joiners
process.text: The same team fits the kitchen and worktops on site.

faqs.a: In our joinery workshop at Unit 1, Merrywell Business Park, Drumree, Co. Meath. Our own joiners then fit them.

faqs.q: Can you work from my architect's drawings?
faqs.a: Yes. We price and build from your architect's or designer's drawings. In Leixlip we built the kitchen to the architect's plan and elevation.
Yes. Kitchen design, including 3D views, is part of what we offer.

faqs.q: Can the kitchen be part of an extension or renovation?
faqs.a: Yes. Most of the kitchens shown here were made for our extension and renovation projects.
No. Every kitchen is made to measure, so we prepare a detailed written quotation once the layout and finishes are agreed.

faqs.q: Do you work in my area?
faqs.a: We work within 50 km of Dunshaughlin, Co. Meath. That covers all of Dublin and towns in Meath, Kildare, Louth (such as Drogheda) and north Wicklow.
